Class NamedCircuits

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.retry.intercept.NamedCircuits
@Internal @Singleton public final class NamedCircuits extends Object
The circuits of the named circuit breakers, shared by the CircuitBreakerRegistry and the methods annotated @CircuitBreaker(name = "...").

The reset timeout and the rolling window of a circuit are those of its configuration under micronaut.retry.circuit-breakers.<name>, if any: a user that declares different ones fails. Without a configuration, every user of the name must declare the same ones, the defaults included: a user that disagrees with the one that created the circuit fails, with both named, whichever came first.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
